_comment: Flash and SRAM claims made by this repository's patches, in dm32uv-re's data/allocations.json format.
Plan and survey: docs/flash-allocation.md. Passed to build_manifest_patch.py with --extra-allocations by tools/build_image.py.

allocations.name: kraken_ui_code
allocations.owner: kraken_ui patch: KRAKEN menu category, screen runner, screens

allocations.name: kraken_ui_data
allocations.owner: kraken_ui patch: relocated menu jump tables and label arrays

allocations.name: kraken_ui_code2
allocations.owner: kraken_ui2 blob: extension screens (APRS beacon/callsign, audio probe, APRS RX, AFSK decoder) + libgcc; screen table first at 0x030ee000 (widened 2026-10-16 for the FM Send RAM beacon method); widened again 2026-10-29 to 0x030f8000 for F3/F9/F11/F12/F13; shrunk 2026-10-30 to the space the v46 link maps measured.

allocations.name: kraken_ui2_state
allocations.owner: kraken_ui2 blob .bss; shrunk 2026-10-30 to the space the v46 link maps measured.

allocations.name: kraken_afsk_state
allocations.owner: kraken_ui2 blob: AFSK/AX.25 decoder state (.bss.afsk); since 2026-11-05 also the 20-byte CW ID state at its tail (krk_cwid.c) and the 4-byte Freq Unlock word (krk_band.c)

allocations.name: kraken_ui3_code
allocations.owner: kraken_ui3 blob: F10 satellite mode (SGP4, TLE table, screens). The flagged literals into 0x030f8000/0x030fd000/0x030fe000 are coincidences (docs/flash-allocation.md, re-checked 2026-10-29)

allocations.name: kraken_ui4_code
allocations.owner: kraken_ui4 blob: F13 burst voice (modem, framing, AMBE packing, screens). 0x030e8000-0x030ea000 was dm32uv-re's Snake claim (excluded in image.json: Snake and this image are mutually exclusive); 0x030ed000's flagged literal is a coincidence (docs/flash-allocation.md, re-checked 2026-10-29)

allocations.name: kraken_ui5_code
allocations.owner: kraken_ui5 blob: F3 DMR link screen (moved out of kraken_ui2 on 2026-10-30 to free ui2). This sector was dm32uv-re's ramdump_probe_code claim (a debug probe that is not in this image; excluded in image.json)

allocations.name: kraken_ui_state2
allocations.owner: kraken_ui main blob .bss.krk_list (KRAKEN visible list + label array); the main claim was full

allocations.name: kraken_feat_state
allocations.owner: kraken_ui2 blob .bss.feat: state of the 2026-10-29 features (F3 BER, F9 parrot control, F11 squelch, F12 scrambler, F13 burst control); shrunk 2026-10-30 to the space the v46 link maps measured.

allocations.name: kraken_bigbuf
allocations.owner: kraken_ui2 blob .bss.big: one 5.5 KiB buffer shared by F9 parrot and F13 burst voice (one owner at a time)

allocations.name: kraken_ui4_state
allocations.owner: kraken_ui4 blob .bss (F13 burst voice modem/framing state). Was dm32uv-re's snake_state plus the unclaimed gap to mi_rng_state (excluded in image.json)

_comment: 16-byte records of ours inside stock data-chip logical block 4 (Radio Settings), written through stock flash_block_write.
Not flash or SRAM claims: the builder and tools/gen_claims.py read only 'allocations'. The span 0xF10-0xFEF of block 4 is reached
by no stock code, is 00 in the factory capture and in both CPS snapshots of this radio (2026-09-26) and FF in a vendor CPS write
(docs/settings-field.md 3.3); records go downwards from 0xFE0. tests/test_bvcfg.py checks the Burst Voice record against this list.

records.name: aprs_callsign
records.owner: krk_callsign.c (blob ui3): APRS callsign, SSID, analog path, CW ID byte (docs/settings-field.md, docs/cw-id.md); since 2026-10-15

records.name: freq_unlock
records.owner: krk_band.c (blob ui2): the Freq Unlock switch (docs/freq-unlock.md); since 2026-11-05

records.name: burst_voice_cfg
records.owner: krk_bvcfg.c (blob ui2): Burst Voice Mode, Key-up Lead, Relay Capture (docs/burst-voice.md 13); since 2026-11-06
